threat_event: Information-stealing malware on the laptop takes saved passwords and session tokens, including the Client A gateway, and an attacker views Client A's spillway gate and unit control screens and the CEII and client files on the laptop
threat_source: Cybercriminal or hostile actor targeting dam operators through their vendors
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Daily work in the administrator account on a mixed-use laptop; browser saves the gateway password and keeps sessions; shared home Wi-Fi; no security training on malware
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-02 laptop; SYS-06 Client A gateway account; Client A HMI and historian (view-only); BP-01; BP-03
regulatory_driver: C-DAMS-R01 (Rev. 3A Table 9.3a remote and third-party connections via CSCA-A (3)); C-DAMS-R02 (Client A's 12.10 duty if a security incident is confirmed)
existing_controls: Client A enforces MFA, view-only roles, and session windows; built-in antivirus; full-disk encryption
treatment_plan: Standard daily account; password manager replaces the browser store; gateway sessions only from the standard account over the phone hotspot until the business network exists; annual course that covers infostealers; P08 runbook; obtain a cyber insurance quote

threat_event: Client A security-sensitive material (Security Plan sections, Form 3 answers) is downloaded, synced, printed, or kept outside Client A's portal and is disclosed
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Portal allowed downloads; no written handling rule before 2026-08-31; files sync automatically to the suite
affected_asset_or_process: Client A security-sensitive material; SYS-01; SYS-02
existing_controls: June copies deleted 2026-07-21; recycle bin emptied 2026-07-23; Client A told 2026-07-22
treatment_plan: POL-01 rule: read security-sensitive material only in the portal or on site; Client A sets the folder to view-only; monthly search of the suite and laptop for Client A marked files

threat_event: An attacker takes over the accounting SaaS or the Client B platform account, which use a password only
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No MFA on either account; two passwords reused; no password manager
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-05 accounting SaaS (holds the W-9); SYS-06 Client B platform account
existing_controls: Unique password on the Client B account
treatment_plan: Turn on MFA on both accounts; unique passphrases in the password manager

threat_event: Field photos of gate controls, galleries, and security features are exposed through the personal photo cloud or the field assistant's phone
threat_source: Owner error; device or account compromise
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Camera roll syncs to a personal consumer photo cloud; field assistant photographed the Client B site on a personal phone with no agreement
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-03 phone; personal photo cloud; field assistant's phone
regulatory_driver: C-DAMS-R01 (Rev. 3A 3.2 OPSEC via CSCA-A (1) and (9)); GRS-B (1)
treatment_plan: Turn off photo sync and delete cloud copies; move field photos to owner-only client folders the same day; field assistant agreement that bars personal photos and requires deletion of the Client B photos

threat_event: The unencrypted USB backup drive with CEII and all client files is lost or stolen
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Drive not encrypted; kept on the desk; sometimes taken to the field as a spare
affected_asset_or_process: USB backup drive; CEII (Client A and upstream project); BP-03
regulatory_driver: 18 CFR 388.113(h)(2) (secure place; report unauthorized disclosures); C-DAMS-R01 (CSCA-A (1))
treatment_plan: Replace with an encrypted drive; wipe the old drive; keep it in the locked cabinet; never take it to the field

threat_event: Laptop failure, theft, or ransomware loses model files, software configuration, and the CEII archive, and the backup cannot be restored
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Model files and CEII archive not synced; monthly backup only; no restore ever tested
existing_controls: Suite version history for synced project folders
treatment_plan: Weekly encrypted backup; first restore test by 2026-09-30, then each quarter

threat_event: Client B instrument readings sent to the AI anomaly detection vendor are kept or reused by the vendor, breaching Client B's confidentiality clause
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Trial started under click-through terms before any review or client consent
affected_asset_or_process: SYS-08 AI tool; Client B data
existing_controls: Use stopped 2026-07-20; Client B told 2026-07-24; deletion requested
treatment_plan: Do not resume; keep the vendor's deletion confirmation; reuse only under the P10 conditions and with Client B's written consent

threat_event: A household device on the shared home Wi-Fi is compromised and used to attack the laptop or the gateway session
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Home Wi-Fi shared with household devices and a smart TV
existing_controls: Host firewall on; all services use TLS; router updates itself
treatment_plan: Separate business network for the laptop and tablet; phone hotspot for gateway sessions until then

threat_event: A security incident is not recognized, or a 24-hour client notice or the report of an unauthorized CEII disclosure to FERC is missed
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No incident plan, contact sheet, or training before 2026-08-31
treatment_plan: Adopt the P08 runbook, notification matrix, and printed contact sheet; walkthrough with the IT technician

threat_event: Client material kept after an engagement ends (a former client's 2025 drawings) is disclosed or breaches a return or destroy duty
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No client information register; no certificates of return or destruction
treatment_plan: Client information register; shred the 2025 drawings and send the former client a certificate

threat_event: The field assistant mishandles client information or enters a restricted area without the client's approval
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: No written agreement; no briefing on security-sensitive information; not yet approved by Client A
regulatory_driver: C-DAMS-R01 (Rev. 3A Table 9.3a roles with third-party contractors via CSCA-A (9))
treatment_plan: Signed field assistant agreement and briefing; ask Client A for written approval before the 2026-11-16 inspection

threat_event: The owner is suddenly unavailable or loses the only phone, so no one can reach clients, meet a 24-hour notice, or complete Client A's inspection
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: One person holds every role and credential; FERC approval and CEII access are personal; no peer arrangement
existing_controls: Suite recovery codes in the locked cabinet
treatment_plan: Peer engineer arrangement; sealed emergency sheet with the owner's attorney; client call list (P05)

threat_event: An attacker steals the digital signing certificate and forges or alters a sealed report
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Certificate in the laptop store, unlocked by the daily administrator login
treatment_plan: Move the certificate to a hardware token with a PIN; standard daily account

threat_event: The email and file suite is unavailable for more than one working day
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Single SaaS dependency for email and files
existing_controls: Provider availability commitments (SOC 2, P09); phone as fallback for client contact
treatment_plan: Accepted: residual risk Low. Keep the printed client contact sheet current

threat_event: A hurricane closes the home office or cancels a field window for several days
vulnerability_or_predisposing_condition: Single home office; field dates booked weeks ahead
existing_controls: SaaS reachable from anywhere over the phone hotspot; laptop travels with the owner
treatment_plan: Accepted: residual risk Low. Move the laptop, tablet, and encrypted backup with the owner when a storm watch is issued; reschedule field work with the client
